title: The Greenlight: five filters
ig: Before we recommend any platform, it has to pass five filters: The Edge, The Backbone, The Shield, The Fit and The Door. Technology-agnostic. Never technology-indifferent.
li:
The Greenlight: five filters before we recommend anything.

The Edge: a real, proprietary advantage.
The Backbone: cloud-native, real APIs, built to connect.
The Shield: compliance for your industry.
The Fit: economics sized for companies of 10 to 250 people.
The Door: reciprocal value.

Only what passes all five gets Greenlit. We only recommend what we would buy ourselves.

Technology-agnostic. Never technology-indifferent.
